# BuildVision AI

> AI-powered construction takeoff and estimating platform helping contractors bid faster, win more work, and manage projects efficiently.

BuildVision AI provides automated blueprint analysis, material quantification, and proposal generation for general contractors, electricians, plumbers, roofers, and subcontractors. The platform streamlines the bidding process by converting PDFs and CAD files into accurate estimates and bills of quantities.

## Key Topics

- AI Takeoffs
- Blueprint Analysis
- Bill of Quantities (BOQ)
- Quote Generation
- Construction Estimating
- Bid Management
- Cost Estimation
- Proposal Generation
- Contractor Tools
- Construction Software
- PDF/CAD Processing
- MEP Systems
- Construction AI
- Subcontractor Solutions
- Owner-Operator Tools

## Trade-Specific Solutions

- [AI Takeoffs & Estimating for General Contractors | BuildVision AI](https://www.buildvisionai.com/solutions/general-contractors): AI takeoff and estimating solution tailored for general contractors and multi-trade projects.
- [AI Electrical Takeoffs & Estimating | BuildVision AI](https://www.buildvisionai.com/solutions/electricians): AI electrical takeoff tool counting outlets, switches, and fixtures from plans.
- [AI Plumbing Takeoffs & Estimating | BuildVision AI](https://www.buildvisionai.com/solutions/plumbers): AI plumbing takeoff software measuring pipes, fixtures, and fittings from plans.
- [AI Roofing Takeoffs & Estimating | BuildVision AI](https://www.buildvisionai.com/solutions/roofers): AI roofing takeoff tool calculating areas, squares, and material quantities.
- [AI Takeoffs for Subcontractors | Price Your Scope Faster | BuildVision AI](https://www.buildvisionai.com/solutions/subcontractors): AI takeoff solution for subcontractors to price scope and win more bids.
- [AI Takeoffs for Owner-Operators | Quote Jobs Faster | BuildVision AI](https://www.buildvisionai.com/solutions/owner-operators): Mobile-first AI takeoff platform for owner-operators to quote jobs on the spot.
